title: Cancellation closes the keystone authority (mirror of refund)
summary: A cancellation receipt whose mandate_ref is the exact mandate the keystone used, closing the authority before execution. The authority-side mirror of refund_execution_v1 (which binds the execution after the payment commits). Reason is byte-load-bearing. Published cancellation_receipt_lite_v1 golden; no new hashing primitive.

tamper.note: MERCHANT_REQUESTED over the same mandate diverges cancellation_ref; the closed-enum reason is byte-load-bearing.
